title: Furnished apartment 100 m from the sea
description: A fully equipped and furnished 51 m² apartment in one of the most attractive locations in Srima, 100 m from the sea, in a quiet street a few minutes' walk from one of the best beaches on this part of the coast.
Open-plan living room with kitchen and dining area, one bedroom with access to the balcony, a bathroom, a separate toilet and a covered balcony with an outdoor dining table.

It is ready to move into and is sold with all the furniture and equipment shown in the photos. Srima is known for its beaches, clear sea and the promenade to Vodice; the centre and a shop are 500 m away.

title: Building plots in Vrpolje, 2 km from the sea
description: Several residential building plots in Vrpolje, near Šibenik, in a quiet location 2 km from the sea. All plots are zoned for housing.

title: Renovated apartment on the main square, sea view
description: A fully renovated and modern furnished apartment in the heart of Šibenik, in an authentic stone house on Medulić, the main square, with a view of the sea.
The apartment has 75.12 m²: two bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen, two bathrooms and a hallway. It is a registered unit with its own title (etaža).

A few steps from the waterfront, restaurants and shops. Thanks to a high-quality renovation and carefully chosen furniture it is ready to move into without further investment. Ideal to live in, for holidays or for holiday rental.

title: Sunset Homes: new apartments with open sea view
description: Modern apartments in a new building in Primošten with a wide, open view of the sea. The building is in a quiet, sunny spot, about 1,500 m from the sea and beach and 2,000 m from the centre of Primošten.

Modern architecture, high-quality materials, large glass walls and spacious terraces. Every apartment has a parking or garage space. The ground-floor apartment S1 has its own garden and a jacuzzi on the terrace.
Completion is planned for 2026. Ideal as a holiday home or a rental investment.

title: Modern semi-detached duplex with pool option
description: A modern semi-detached duplex house in Brodarica near Šibenik, 500 m from the sea. Each unit has about 120 m² of living space over two floors and its own garden of about 200 m².

The ground floor (about 60 m²) is open plan: a large living room, a kitchen with an island, a dining area, a bathroom and a storage room, with large glass walls to the garden and a terrace with a pergola. A 3 × 6 m pool or a jacuzzi can be added.
The upper floor (about 60 m²) is the sleeping area: a master bedroom with its own bathroom and a large terrace with a sea view, two more bedrooms and another bathroom.
The project is a concept design, so the buyer can still change the layout, terraces, pool, facade and interior before construction, within the regulations. The images are visualisations.

title: Renovated stone house 30 m from the sea
description: A fully renovated traditional Dalmatian stone house in the heart of Šepurina on the island of Prvić, about 30 m from the sea.

The house has a ground floor and two upper floors (footprint 3.5 × 5 m), with two bedrooms and two bathrooms. The stone walls and the roof have been restored, keeping the authentic look: exposed stone and a wooden roof structure.
It stands in a quiet stone street of the old village core. Ideal for holidays, holiday rental or as an investment on an attractive island.

title: Building plot with permit and sea view
description: A 712 m² building plot in Rogoznica with a beautiful view of the sea, sold with a design for a house of 150 m² and a valid building permit.
The images include visualisations of the permitted house with a swimming pool. Ask us for the project documents.

title: G Home: new apartments 100 m from the beach
description: The last apartments in G Home, a new project in Grebaštica only 100 m from the sea and the beach. Two small buildings with just six apartments in total mean peace and privacy all year round.
Pre-sale price before construction starts: €3,200 per m². Every apartment comes with two parking spaces, large terraces and a practical layout. Completion is planned for 2027.

Grebaštica is one of the most sought-after places on the Šibenik riviera, known for clear sea, beautiful beaches and quiet surroundings, a few minutes' drive from Šibenik and Primošten. Ask us for floor plans and to reserve an apartment.

title: New semi-detached house 70 m from the sea
description: A modern semi-detached house in Žaborić, a quiet Mediterranean village near Šibenik, only 70 m from the sea and a beach. Unit S2 of a new two-unit house is for sale: 99.71 m² over two floors, with a private garden of 135 m² and two parking spaces.

The ground floor has an entrance hall, one bedroom, a bathroom, a modern kitchen with dining area and a large living room opening onto the garden and terrace. Upstairs are two bedrooms, two bathrooms and a balcony with a view of the surroundings and the sea.
Large glass walls bring in plenty of daylight. The house is sold unfurnished; some images are renders.
Beaches, a seaside promenade, restaurants, shops and a marina are nearby. Šibenik, the Krka and Kornati national parks and Split airport are a short drive away.
standards: Underfloor heating in the living room and bathrooms
Air conditioning in the living room and every bedroom
PVC windows with good thermal insulation
features: 70 m to the sea and beach

title: Olive Grove: villa plot with building permit
description: A building plot of 1,523 m² on a hillside among olive trees above Primošten, sold with a building permit for a modern stone villa of about 330 m² gross area.

The design combines modern architecture with a Mediterranean feel: several levels following the terrain, large glass walls, spacious terraces and an outdoor area with a swimming pool, sun deck and lounge.
The plot is quiet and surrounded by nature, with an open view of the sea. Split airport is about 40 km away. The images are visualisations of the permitted villa.

title: Sun Hill, Primošten Resort
description: Sun Hill is one of the settlements of Primošten Resort, a development of new apartments and villas above Primošten.
Prices, floor plans and availability of the individual units are available on request. See the Primošten Resort page for all units.

title: House in the first row to the sea, Tisno
description: A house in the very centre of Tisno, in the first row to the sea, with an open view.

The basement has a small garage and a room with a bathroom and a kitchen. The ground floor has a living room with a kitchen, a bathroom, a dressing room and large terraces at the front and back. The first floor is an unfinished apartment with one bedroom, a bathroom and a toilet.
The house needs renovation. It faces south-east.
features: Terraces at the front and back

title: New apartments in the centre of Primošten
description: A new apartment building in the centre of Primošten, with an elevator, garages and terraces with glass railings. Apartment prices include VAT.
standards: Reinforced concrete structure on a 40 cm foundation slab; 25 cm load-bearing walls
Facade insulated with 10 cm of stone wool (ETICS)
Anthracite aluminium windows with triple glazing, motorised insulated roller shutters and built-in mosquito nets
Samsung multi-split inverter air conditioning built into the ceilings
Electric underfloor heating in the bathrooms, Geberit built-in cisterns
Ceramic floors of the buyer's choice by agreement; epoxy floors in garages and storage
Preparation for an electric car charger at every garage space
Double-waterproofed terraces with hidden drainage; roof insulated with 15 cm XPS

title: Modern new building with sea view
description: A new urban villa in Brodarica with three residential units in a row, modern architecture and a view of the sea.
Each unit has its own garden with room for a swimming pool (not included in the price).

title: Modern apartment with pool
description: A modern apartment in a new building of four units in Primošten. Large glass walls give every apartment an open view of the old town on its peninsula.
Apartment 3 has its own swimming pool and a total area of 136.39 m². The building has an excellent access road from the main street.
A garage space is available at €1,500 per m², and an outdoor parking space for €5,000.

title: New 4 bedroom villa near Vodice
description: A new 330 m² villa on a 460 m² garden near Vodice, built with care for every detail and for privacy.
It has four bedrooms, each with its own bathroom, a guest toilet, a fitness room and a 40 m² swimming pool. Schüco windows, underfloor heating, fully equipped and furnished.
The centre and restaurants are 1 km away, with walks in nature right around the house and a beautiful view.

title: Modern villa on the hill above Primošten
description: A modern 343 m² villa on a 1,038 m² plot on the hill above Primošten, with privacy and a sea view.
Four bedrooms, four bathrooms and two toilets, and a 40 m² swimming pool. Underfloor heating, a heat pump and central cooling.
The price is for the fully equipped villa.
